title: Ohio Woman Kills Roommate During Heated Argument
description:
Bodycam footage from Riverside, Ohio captures police responding to a shooting inside a home where 25-year-old Halle Harvey allegedly shot her roommate Shyanne Mitchell. Watch as officers secure the chaotic scene and investigators begin piecing together what happened.
